open_issues.impact: concurrent attach/init/sync during an interactive confirm
open_issues.next: move the confirmation outside the lock and re-read the marker after it if this proves annoying
open_issues.text: attach holds the shared workspace git.lock for the whole operation, including an interactive confirmation prompt; a long prompt can make a concurrent workspace git command wait or hit WORKSPACE_GIT_LOCKED after the lock timeout.

open_issues.text: cli._publish_text prints local_only paths raw; a size/binary-limited file whose name is not UTF-8 would still raise UnicodeEncodeError in the text output (JSON output is display-escaped). cli.py is outside the scope and was not changed.

summary: No code change in this round; the candidate from the previous round was re-verified. All five findings are fixed: safety.scan judges both the staged index blob and the working-tree file; gitutil decodes git output with surrogateescape (round-trips undecodable pathnames) and offers a binary mode and git_bytes; the placeholder exemption requires the whole value to match a placeholder or env:// reference shape; projects.attach runs under gitutil.git_lock; attach creates plans/.gitkeep so the empty plan store survives git transfer. Each has a test. Ran tests.test_safety, test_localonly, test_projects, test_cli, test_doctor, test_init from packages/workspace: 143 tests OK. V2-V4 are left to the coordinator.
